title: メカトロニクス
subtitle: Mechatronics
teachers:
FURUYA Shigehiko
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Understand mechatronics, a multidisciplinary field of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and computer engineering.
Learn sensor technology, principles of motors, and electrical and electronic circuits for sensors and motors.
advice:
Course Content

1.Sensor Selection and Circuit Design
Students will learn how to interpret data sheets for various sensors and develop a deeper understanding of sensor circuits that interface with microcontrollers.

2.DC Servo Motors and Control Circuits
The course will cover the characteristics and selection methods of DC servo motors, which serve as representative actuators in robotic systems, along with an in-depth study of motor control circuits.

3.Mechanical Transmission and Motor Selection
Students will learn how to mathematically model mechanical transmission mechanisms and apply these models to select appropriate DC motors for specific applications.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Appropriately select sensors and motors for making a new mechatronic system.
(2) Design an interface circuit to connect sensors and actuators using microcomputers.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Select sensors and DC motors for making a required mechatronic system.
(2) Select IO ports of a microcomputer to connect sensors and DC motors.
